title: Health Officials Investigate Possible Link Between Ebola Cases in Nigeria and Kenya
subtitle: Authorities are looking into whether two patients met at a Ugandan airport as the virus spreads to new regions.

summary.en: Health authorities are investigating a possible connection between the first Ebola cases in Nigeria and Kenya. Both patients were at a Ugandan airport on the same day, raising concerns about the spread of the virus. The current outbreak, which began in the Democratic Republic of Congo, is the fastest-spreading one on record. Nigeria is the fourth country to report a case, marking the first time the virus has reached West Africa in this wave. Officials are now working to trace contacts and prevent further transmission of the deadly disease.
summary.zh: 衛生當局正調查奈及利亞與肯亞首例伊波拉病例之間可能的關聯。兩名病患曾在同一天出現在烏干達的機場，引發了對病毒擴散的擔憂。這場始於剛果民主共和國的疫情，是有紀錄以來擴散速度最快的一次。奈及利亞是第四個通報病例的國家，這也標誌著病毒在此波疫情中首次抵達西非。官員們目前正致力於追蹤接觸者，並防止這種致命疾病進一步傳播。

paragraphs.en: Health officials are working quickly to determine if the first Ebola cases in Nigeria and Kenya are connected. According to NPR News, investigators are looking into whether the two patients met at an airport in Uganda. This new development comes just days after Nigeria confirmed its first case of the virus in over ten years.
paragraphs.zh: 衛生官員正加緊作業，以釐清奈及利亞與肯亞的首例伊波拉病毒病例是否互有關聯。根據美國國家公共廣播電台（NPR）報導，調查人員正在追查這兩名病患是否曾在烏干達的一座機場相遇。在此之前，奈及利亞才剛證實出現十年多來的首起病毒病例，隨即傳出這項新進展。

paragraphs.en: The patient in Nigeria is a woman who was born in Uganda and is married to a diplomat. She had been on vacation in Uganda during September before returning to Nigeria earlier this month. Nigerian health authorities are currently treating her, and they have placed 44 people who had close contact with her into quarantine — a process of separating people who may have been exposed to a disease to see if they get sick. Dr. Wessam Mankoula, who leads emergency response efforts at the Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, confirmed these details during a recent press briefing.
paragraphs.zh: 奈及利亞的病患是一名出生於烏干達的女性，其丈夫為外交官。她在九月期間曾於烏干達度假，並於本月初返回奈及利亞。奈及利亞衛生當局目前正對她進行治療，並已將四十四名曾與她密切接觸的人員進行隔離，這是一種將可能接觸過疾病的人員分開，以觀察其是否發病的方法。非洲疾病管制暨預防中心（Africa CDC）負責緊急應變工作的曼庫拉醫師（Dr. Wessam Mankoula）在近期的一場記者會中證實了這些細節。

paragraphs.en: Ebola is a serious illness that causes a high fever and can be fatal. It spreads through direct contact with the bodily fluids of an infected person or with items that have been touched by an infected person. Experts generally note that people are not able to spread the virus to others until they start showing symptoms, such as fever or other signs of illness. Because of this, officials are carefully checking the timeline of the patients' travels to understand how the virus might be moving across the continent.
paragraphs.zh: 伊波拉是一種會導致高燒且可能致命的嚴重疾病。它透過直接接觸感染者的體液，或是接觸過感染者碰觸過的物品而傳播。專家普遍指出，病患在出現發燒或其他疾病徵兆等症狀之前，並不會將病毒傳染給他人。因此，官員們正仔細核對病患的旅遊時序，以了解病毒如何在非洲大陸擴散。

paragraphs.en: The investigation focuses on the Entebbe International Airport in Uganda. Officials believe that the first patient from Kenya and the first patient from Nigeria were both at this airport on the same day. Dr. Mankoula stated that his team is looking into whether there was any kind of interaction between these two individuals while they were at the facility. The Kenyan patient, who has since passed away, had traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo to Kenya by way of Uganda.
paragraphs.zh: 調查重點集中在烏干達的恩德培國際機場（Entebbe International Airport）。官員認為，肯亞的首例病患與奈及利亞的首例病患，曾在同一天出現在這座機場。曼庫拉醫師表示，他的團隊正在調查這兩人在機場期間是否有過任何互動。該名肯亞病患已不幸過世，他當時是從剛果民主共和國經由烏干達前往肯亞。

paragraphs.en: This situation is particularly concerning because Nigeria is the fourth country to report an Ebola case during the current outbreak. It is also the first time the virus has reached West Africa in this wave, and it is the furthest location from the original center of the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The outbreak in Congo began in the eastern part of the country in May and has since become the fastest-spreading one ever recorded. Reports from the region indicate that at least 4,600 people have died, and approximately 9,700 people have been infected.
paragraphs.zh: 此情況特別令人擔憂，因為奈及利亞是本次疫情中第四個通報伊波拉病例的國家。這也是病毒在此波疫情中首次抵達西非，且距離疫情最初爆發中心剛果民主共和國最為遙遠。剛果的疫情於五月在該國東部爆發，隨後成為有紀錄以來擴散速度最快的一次。該地區的報告顯示，至少已有四千六百人死亡，約九千七百人遭到感染。

paragraphs.en: Neighboring countries are also feeling the pressure of the virus. Uganda had previously recorded about 20 cases, but the country was declared free of Ebola in August. However, the appearance of the virus in other nations shows how quickly it can travel through international travel hubs. In Kenya, eight other cases have been confirmed since the first patient was identified in early October.
paragraphs.zh: 鄰近國家也感受到病毒帶來的壓力。烏干達先前曾記錄約二十起病例，但該國已於八月宣布脫離伊波拉疫情。然而，病毒出現在其他國家顯示出它透過國際交通樞紐傳播的速度有多快。在肯亞，自十月初確認首例病患以來，已證實另外八起病例。

paragraphs.en: As health authorities continue their investigation, the focus remains on stopping the spread. Tracing the movements of infected individuals is a critical step in public health to ensure that anyone who might have been exposed receives medical attention. The Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention continues to monitor the situation closely, working with local governments to manage the risks. For now, the public is being urged to follow health guidelines and report any symptoms to local clinics immediately. The international community is watching the situation closely, as the rapid movement of the virus across borders presents a significant challenge for health systems in the region.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著衛生當局持續調查，重點仍放在阻止病毒擴散。追蹤感染者的行蹤是公共衛生中確保任何可能接觸者能獲得醫療照護的關鍵步驟。非洲疾病管制暨預防中心持續密切監控局勢，並與當地政府合作以管理風險。目前，大眾被呼籲遵循衛生準則，並向當地診所即時通報任何症狀。國際社會正密切關注此情況，因為病毒跨越國界的快速移動，對該地區的醫療體系構成了重大挑戰。

keyTerms.noteZh: 這是一個常見的片語，但容易與單純的「往裡面看」混淆。文中：According to NPR News, investigators are looking into whether the two patients met at an airport in Uganda.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A polite or euphemistic way to say that someone has died.
keyTerms.noteZh: 這是「die」的委婉說法，在新聞報導中常用來表示尊重。文中：The Kenyan patient, who has since passed away, had traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo to Kenya by way of Uganda.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Traveling through or via a particular place.
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面上看起來像「用……的方法」，但在這裡指交通路徑。文中：The Kenyan patient, who has since passed away, had traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo to Kenya by way of Uganda.

quiz.question: What is the current status of the 44 individuals who had contact with the patient in Nigeria?

options.A: They have been confirmed to have the Ebola virus.
options.B: They are being isolated to monitor for potential signs of illness.
options.C: They have all been released after testing negative for the virus.
options.D: They are receiving medical treatment at the Africa Centers for Disease Control.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，衛生當局將這 44 名密切接觸者進行「隔離」（quarantine），目的是觀察他們是否會發病。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章並未說他們已確診；選項 C 錯誤，因為文中未提到他們已解除隔離；選項 D 錯誤，因為文中提到接受治療的是那位女病患，而非這 44 名接觸者。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, why are health officials investigating the Entebbe International Airport?

options.A: It is the primary location where the Ebola outbreak originally began.
options.B: It is the only airport in the region that remains open during the outbreak.
options.C: They suspect it may be the point of transmission between the Nigerian and Kenyan patients.
options.D: The airport staff failed to report the symptoms of the infected travelers.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第四段，官員認為奈及利亞與肯亞的首位病患在同一天都出現在該機場，且調查重點在於兩人之間是否曾有接觸。這暗示了機場可能是病毒傳播的節點。選項 A 錯誤，因為爆發中心在剛果；選項 B 文中未提及；選項 D 則是過度推論，文中並未指責機場人員失職。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the word 'trace' mean in the context of 'Tracing the movements of infected individuals'?

options.A: To follow or map out the path someone has taken.
options.B: To copy a drawing or design by following its lines.
options.C: To find a very small amount of a substance.
options.D: To describe the history of a family or group.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在公共衛生語境下，「trace」指追蹤病患的活動軌跡，以利防疫。選項 B 是指繪畫上的「臨摹」；選項 C 是指「微量」；選項 D 則是「追溯血緣」。這些選項雖然在其他情境下正確，但在文中描述防疫行動時，只有 A 符合「追蹤路徑」的意涵。

quiz.question: What is the central message of the article regarding the Ebola situation?

options.A: The Ebola virus is primarily spreading through the diplomatic community in West Africa.
options.B: Uganda has successfully contained the virus and is no longer a risk to other nations.
options.C: Health experts have already identified the exact cause of the current outbreak.
options.D: The rapid spread of Ebola through international travel hubs poses a major challenge to regional health systems.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。本文主要討論伊波拉病毒如何透過國際旅遊樞紐（如機場）快速擴散，並對非洲各國的衛生體系造成巨大壓力與挑戰。選項 A 過於狹隘，僅提到外交官；選項 B 與文中提到的「病毒再次出現」衝突；選項 C 錯誤，因為調查仍在進行中，尚未確定傳播細節。
